name: Sentire
description: The Sentire Surgical System (Model C1000) is a multiport teleoperated robotic platform developed by Cornerstone Robotics (Hong Kong, China) for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery. Its mechanical and industrial design closely resembles the Intuitive Surgical [da Vinci X](/robot/intuitive_da_vinci_X) across both the enclosed 3D stereoscopic surgeon console and the single column-mounted 4-arm patient cart with mechanical remote center of motion (RCM) linkages. Operating wristed articulating laparoscopic instruments and a 3D HD endoscope, the Sentire C1000 received China NMPA approval in 2024 and European CE MDR certification in 2026 for general abdominal, urological, gynecological, and thoracic surgical procedures.

publications.title: Evaluation of the safety and efficacy of the Sentire Surgical System (C1000) for robot-assisted radical prostatectomy
